{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies error responses in src/rpc/util.cpp and updates tests for rpc_getdescriptorinfo and rpc_scantxoutset.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.68,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Prevents RPC error replies from echoing raw private key material back to callers and downstream logs. The RPC rubric highlights interface security and 'exposure of sensitive data', which this directly mitigates across descriptor-related RPCs."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/util/bip32.cpp (+2/-0) only to support descriptor parsing error truncation, not to change utility infrastructure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "A minor two-line edit to BIP32 utilities solely follows the descriptor error-handling changes and does not make this a utils change."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies descriptor parsing and wallet import/spend error paths in src/script/descriptor.cpp, src/wallet/imports.cpp, and src/wallet/rpc/spend.cpp.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.72,
      "reason_tag": "fund safety",
      "rationale": "Prevents secret key material (WIF keys, xprvs) from leaking into error messages during descriptor parsing, wallet imports, and transaction funding. As the author notes, 'the reply then carries the key into places the request may not go: an application's error log, an error reporter, a screenshot shared for help', threatening key confidentiality and fund safety."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 2,
    "bug_severity": 2,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 1,
    "leverage": 0
  }
}
